# Calculator

This file is a map of the documentation repository. It does not place these pages in a search index, a generative answer, or a citation graph.

## Purpose

Engineering formula notes for 11 calculator websites. Each English topic names a production tool, a formula or algorithm, a worked example, limits, and the calculation check. Standards citations stay pending until the cited text and version have been read.

## Languages

English topic files are the source. Twelve NetEngineerLab topics have Simplified Chinese companions named `*.zh-CN.md` in the same directory. Those companions are not extra English topics. Other sites have live localized calculator pages recorded in `config/locale-routes.json`. This repository does not yet have Chinese topic files for those sites.

## The 11 domains

- NetEngineerLab — NetEngineerLab/ — https://netengineerlab.com — optical loss, power budget, latency, dispersion, OSPF cost, STP cost, transfer time, MTU, DNS TTL, switch uplinks
- PCDog — PCDog/ — https://pcdog.com — IPv4 longest prefix, static routes, screen pixels, frame intervals
- AIMarkTool — AIMarkTool/ — https://aimarktool.com — ROAS, LTV/CAC, funnels, sample size
- PowerEngineerLab — PowerEngineerLab/ — https://powerengineerlab.com — Ohm's law, power triangle, reactance, machines, demand and load factor
- HVACEngineerLab — HVACEngineerLab/ — https://hvacengineerlab.com — duct pressure, loads, psychrometrics
- PrivacyFileLab — PrivacyFileLab/ — https://privacyfilelab.com — local SHA-256, redaction, verifier status
- DataFileLab — DataFileLab/ — https://datafilelab.com — CSV frequency, encoding, blank rows, row numbers
- WaterEngineerLab — WaterEngineerLab/ — https://waterengineerlab.com — Manning, rational runoff, Darcy-Weisbach
- StructuralEngineerLab — StructuralEngineerLab/ — https://structuralengineerlab.com — buckling, bending stress, beam deflection
- DevEngineerLab — DevEngineerLab/ — https://devengineerlab.com — timestamps, base conversion, text counts
- DIYCalcLab — DIYCalcLab/ — https://diycalclab.com — concrete, lumber, roof pitch, fence, rebar

## Verification

- Machine-readable topics: indexes/topics.json
- Calculation and standards status: indexes/verification-index.json and reports/FORMULA_VERIFICATION.json
- Locale probes dated 2026-11-10: config/locale-routes.json
- Citation form: docs/CITATION.md

Calculation status VERIFIED means the arithmetic was checked against the production calculator or the published identity. It does not mean a design standard was re-audited. Standards status VERIFIED is limited to the Fed. Std. 376B mechanical horsepower factor checked on 2026-11-10. Two structural beam notes remain calculation REVIEW_REQUIRED because their general integrator was not line-traced.

## Limits

- Do not treat a site homepage as the tool page.
- Do not invent a locale path. On NetEngineerLab the checked Chinese tool path is `/tools/<slug>/zh/`. `/zh-CN/tools/...` on that site returned 404.
- Do not read a pending standards row as confirmation of the standard.
- Promo drafts under promo/ are not formula topics.
